pages.text: Night 9. A tesseract is a 4D cube: take a cube and drag it along a fourth axis, $(thing)W$(), at right angles to the other three. What you see in the assembler is its 3D shadow, rotating through the W axis - the way a cube's shadow on a wall seems to turn inside out.
Edge colour shows depth in W: $(thing)cyan$() near, $(thing)magenta$() far. Watch an edge shift from one to the other and you are watching it travel through a direction you cannot point to.
